name: ICD-10-CM
description: International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision, Clinical Modification. FY27 content is derived from CMS/NCHS Tabular XML and the companion full order file. The root, chapters, sections, concrete diagnosis codes, parent hierarchy, order number, valid-for-submission flag, and leaf status are modeled from those official files. The legacy staging source carried UMLS enrichments (CUI and Semantic Types) that CMS/NCHS does not supply; they are not carried (temporary policy, pending a documented decision). Tabular instructional-note fields (EXCLUDES1, EXCLUDES2, USE ADDITIONAL, CODE FIRST, CODE ALSO, Note) are preserved in an update.
copyright: Developed by the National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS) and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), U.S. Department of Health and Human Services. U.S. government works are not subject to copyright protection within the United States. ICD-10-CM is based on the WHO International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision; WHO authorized NCHS to develop the U.S. clinical modification.

properties.description: OCL class projected from the official FY27 XML role: Root for the synthetic root, Chapter for chapter ranges, Section for section ranges, and Diagnosis for XML diag nodes and concrete seventh-character extensions.

The five-digit, 1-based record sequence in the complete CMS/NCHS FY27 order file. It is a release-local ordering aid, not the ICD-10-CM code or a clinical identifier; it can change whenever a release inserts, removes, or reorders codes.
CMS/NCHS order-file flag: true when the concrete code is valid for submission in the stated fiscal-year release.
Derived from the FY27 hierarchy; false when the concept has a child chapter, a nested structural section, an explicit diagnosis, or a seventh-character extension code.

ICD-10-CM Tabular List Excludes1 instructional note(s): the excluded condition is not coded together with this concept. These notes are official Tabular content and must be preserved or regenerated explicitly in an update.

ICD-10-CM Tabular List Excludes2 instructional note(s): the excluded condition is not part of this concept, but both conditions may be coded when present. These notes are official Tabular content and must be preserved or regenerated explicitly in an update.

ICD-10-CM Tabular List Use Additional Code instructional note(s), carried by the legacy source for applicable concepts. These notes are official Tabular content and must be preserved or regenerated explicitly in an update.
